contexts.text: They are then rolled round and round... like an axle...
Thus the sphere of Divine Good in the midst is like an axis...
The Earth... revolves daily round its axis...
The Ancient Church preserved its axis, which was Noah...
By Noah is signified the Church which lasted on from the Most Ancient to posterity, as a nucleus, or axis.
The influx of Heaven about the ear has its own axis, so that the axis of the influx is there...
The province of the ear is in the axis of Heaven, and therefore the whole Spiritual World inflows into it with the perception that so it should be done.
